obscura

A local-first browser engine for agents, with a Chromium fallback when a page needs full rendering.

Architecture

Obscura runs one process per profile. Each profile owns a cookie jar, a cache directory and a network policy. The engine exposes a narrow command surface: navigate, click, type, scroll, read, screenshot, download.

Chromium fallback

When a page requires JavaScript that Obscura does not implement, the profile spawns a Chromium instance and attaches over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. The fallback is per-tab, so a session can mix both engines.

Permissions

Every command passes a permission check before it reaches the engine. Full computer control is opt-in and can be revoked by the device owner at any time. The permission log is append-only and records who asked for what.

Install

npm install @orcel/obscura

Status

Early. The CDP bridge is tested against Chromium 141. The native layout engine handles static HTML, forms and a subset of CSS. No claims are made about full web compatibility.
